'''Johan van der Meer'''<ref name="dt-5996">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5996 Hand on the Pump], DeckTech (Johan "Johan" van der Meer, 26 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5996/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5996/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018181331/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5996/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (also published as '''Johan Van der Meer'''; DeckTech handle '''Johan''') posted a [[Light]] [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|You Can Either Profit By This]] list on DeckTech in April 2000. His decks were also published on [[Trandosite]], [[Rod Latham]]'s UK fan site.<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls64.htm Force Choke], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228060430/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls64.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
